The second equation represents the perpendicular bisector of the points \(4+k\) and \(k+3i\), which is the line
\[
8x-6y=8k+7.
\]
The first equation is the circle centered at \(25+20i\) with radius \(5\). For exactly one solution, the line must be tangent to the circle, so the distance from \((25,20)\) to the line equals \(5\):
\[
\frac{|8(25)-6(20)-(8k+7)|}{10}=5
\]
\[
\frac{|73-8k|}{10}=5 \implies |73-8k|=50.
\]
Thus
\[
73-8k=50 \implies k=\frac{23}{8},
\]
or
\[
73-8k=-50 \implies k=\frac{123}{8}.
\]
The sum of possible values is
\[
\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]
So \(m=73,\ n=4\), and \(m+n=77\).

ANSWER: 77
